newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Foreigners hungry for S.African asset swaps - paper.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners hungry for S.African asset swaps - paper.

text.p: Asset swaps between South African and foreign institutions this year reached about five billion rand by the end of April, Business Day newspaper said on Wednesday, quoting Reserve Bank figures.
This followed swaps of about 15 billion rand executed last year.

Approvals for swaps which have not necessarily been executed are running at about 40 billion rand and the central bank's exchange control department said it had noticed an increase in demand for swaps.
The government allows local institutions to move up to 10 percent of their investments offshore by swapping stocks and bonds with foreign funds as part of its programme to relax exchange controls.
